english.note: Use 過 as the all-purpose verb for moving past or across a place and for a period, feeling, or situation coming to an end.
This is the all-purpose choice for going from one side of something to the other.

examples.english: We pass over the bridge before going to eat.
examples.traditional: 我哋行過條橋先去食飯。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haang4 gwo3 tiu4 kiu4 sin1 heoi3 sik6 faan6

examples.english: We need to cross the road now.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 gwo3 maa5 lou6

english.note: Use this before the name of a festival or holiday when saying that people celebrate or observe it.

examples.english: We observe the Mid-Autumn Festival every year.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 nin4 nin4 gwo3 zung1 cau1
